wizard.title: Create your invitation
wizard.lead: A few calm steps from idea to invitations on WhatsApp.

errors.dateFuture: The event must be in the future.
errors.mapsInvalid: Paste a Google Maps link, or leave it empty.
errors.hostsRequired: Add the host names shown on the card.
errors.headlineRequired: Add a short headline for the card.
errors.paletteInvalid: Each colour must be a valid hex value.
errors.noGuests: Add at least one guest with a valid Saudi mobile number.
errors.consentRequired: Please confirm you have your guests' permission.

details.title: Tell us about the event
details.lead: These details appear on the invitation and in every WhatsApp message.

title.label: Event name
title.hint: Guests see this in the message, for example "Mohammed & Noura's wedding".

mapsUrl.label: Google Maps link (optional)
mapsUrl.hint: Guests can tap it to get directions.

client.label: Client (optional)
client.hint: Link this event to one of your clients.

template.title: Choose your template
template.lead: Every card already shows your details. Pick the one that feels right.
template.none: No templates available for this occasion yet. Show all occasions to continue.

customize.title: Make it yours
customize.lead: Names, wording, language and colours. The card updates as you type.

headline.label: Headline
headline.hint: A short line under the names.

language.label: Invitation language
language.bothHint: The card is shown in Arabic; messages go out in Arabic and English where supported.

palette.title: Colours
palette.lowContrast: Text and background contrast is {ratio}:1. Aim for at least 4.5:1 so guests can read the card.

ai.title: Adapt this template to my theme
ai.lead: Describe the look you imagine and we will suggest colours and wording.
ai.label: Your theme

guests.title: Add your guests
guests.lead: Upload a spreadsheet or paste a list. We check every Saudi mobile number before anything is sent.

upload.drop: Drop a CSV or Excel file here
upload.formats: Columns: name, phone, optional number of guests (.csv or .xlsx)

guests.importEmpty: We couldn't find any guests in that data.
guests.importError: We couldn't read that file. Try a CSV or .xlsx export.
guests.fileTooBig: That file is too large. The limit is 5 MB.
guests.tooMany: That would exceed the limit of {max} guests per event.
guests.imported: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} imported: {valid} ready, {invalid} need attention.
guests.empty: No guests yet. Upload a file, paste a list, or add a guest manually.

consent.label: I confirm I have my guests' permission to contact them on WhatsApp and understand they can opt out at any time.
consent.hint: Required under Saudi data protection rules (PDPL). Guests can reply STOP to opt out.

preview.title: See it on WhatsApp
preview.lead: This is what your guests will receive, using the first names on your list.

summary.title: Review and price
summary.lead: Check the details, then continue to payment.
summary.minNote: Billing starts from {min} guests, even though your list has {count}.

checkout.title: Payment
checkout.lead: Choose how you would like to pay.
checkout.demoNotice: Demo payment: no card is charged and no real money moves.
checkout.noCard: No card details are collected in this demo.
checkout.secureNote: Invitations are sent right after payment.

success.title: Invitations are on their way
success.lead: "{title}" is live. Guests are receiving their invitation on WhatsApp now.
success.sentAll: {count, plural, one {# invitation sent} other {# invitations sent}}
